author: hdprajwal
abstract: Ensures feature work happens in an isolated workspace before starting. Detects existing isolation first (with a submodule guard), prefers the harness's native worktree tool, falls back to manual git worktree with .gitignore safety checks, runs project setup, and verifies a clean test baseline before handing off. Adapted from obra/superpowers' using-git-worktrees skill. Tuned to hdprajwal's actual workflow (branch → PR → merge loop, specs in docs/, pnpm + cargo, runtime-proof verification, short plain prose) based on usage analysis.
